mapper.sql: r.id, r.student_id, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.target, r.reason, r.referred_by, r.referred_at, r.status, r.follow_note, r.closed_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(u.student_id, '') AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, '') AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u2.real_name, ''), u2.nickname, u2.username) AS referred_by_name
FROM psyche_referral r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = r.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = r.referred_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_referral (student_id, source_type, source_id, target, reason, referred_by, referred_at, status, follow_note, closed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{target}, #{reason}, #{referredBy}, #{referredAt}, #{status}, #{followNote}, #{closedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE psyche_referral SET target = #{referral.target}, reason = #{referral.reason}, status = #{referral.status}, follow_note = #{referral.followNote}, closed_at = #{referral.closedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{referral.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
